requirements.quote: Please provide a lump sum (LS) price that covers the manufacturing, furnishing, delivering, and testing of the new switchgear.
requirements.text: Provide a lump sum price for manufacturing, furnishing, delivering, and testing the switchgear.

requirements.quote: Please also include in your cost proposal:
requirements.text: Include the following items in the cost proposal.

requirements.quote: 1. Special Tools necessary for installation, testing and maintenance.
requirements.text: Provide special tools for installation, testing, and maintenance.

requirements.quote: 2. Necessary drawings, instructions and test reports in the English language.
requirements.text: Provide drawings, instructions, and test reports in English.

requirements.quote: 3. In addition to other Submittal requirements, final drawings shall be submitted as AutoCAD format files.
requirements.text: Submit final drawings in AutoCAD format.
Provide maintenance equipment and spare parts.
